title: Off-stage objects not visible or selectable — no editable pasteboard work area around the stage
description:
REPORTED BUG (user). Shapes/symbols/objects positioned partly or fully OUTSIDE the white stage rect cannot be SEEN or MOVED on the editor stage. This breaks the common Flash workflow of tweening a shape/MovieClip FROM off-screen INTO the stage (you author the start keyframe with the object sitting in the gray pasteboard, off the left/top edge). In real Flash the gray 'pasteboard' work area around the white stage renders off-stage content and lets you fully select/drag it; the white stage rect is only a visual guide for what the SWF crops to.

REPRO: place a shape at e.g. x=-100 (off the left edge) or drag a placed shape off the stage edge, OR set up a motion tween whose start keyframe is off-stage. Actual: the off-stage portion is invisible, and a fully-off-stage object can neither be seen nor clicked/dragged. Expected: it renders on the gray pasteboard and is fully selectable/movable.

ROOT CAUSE (packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx, all HEAD=9febec8):
NOT-RENDERED (the load-bearing cause):
- The render <canvas> is sized to EXACTLY stage W×H: width={stageWidth} height={stageHeight} (StageArea.tsx:4187-4188), and the CanvasRenderer backing buffer is resized to the same: rendererRef.current.resize(stageWidth, stageHeight, dpr) (StageArea.tsx:3342; also :3397,:3456,:3408 for ghost/parent renderers). It sits absolutely at top:0/left:0 inside the stage-sized stageStyle div (StageArea.tsx:3984-3994, width/height = stageWidth/stageHeight at :3986-3987).
- The renderer draws every object at its stage coordinates with NO stage offset/translate and NO pasteboard margin (packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts resize() :1946, clearRect :1864-1869; the only ctx.clip() calls are mask-layer/fill-winding at :1915/:504, NOT a stage-rect clip). So an object at x<0 or x>stageWidth is drawn at a canvas pixel coordinate outside the bitmap and is clipped away by the canvas's own fixed dimensions. Same for the grid overlay and every SVG/preview overlay (all hardcode width:stageWidth height:stageHeight, e.g. :4268-4269,:4308-4309,:4354-4355). The gray 'pasteboard' (workAreaStyle background themeContent.pasteboard, StageArea.tsx:3961-3971) is COSMETIC ONLY — there is no canvas covering it, so nothing can be drawn there.
NOT-SELECTABLE (secondary; the math is fine, visibility is the real blocker):
- toStageCoords (StageArea.tsx:1609-1623) does NOT clamp to the stage rect, and the onMouseDown hit-tests (e.g. :1803,:1833,:2071,:2154,:2276,:2363 via transformedShapeBounds; symbol :2394; text :1936) are pure bounds comparisons with no stage clamp, AND the mouse handlers are attached to workAreaRef (the full gray pasteboard, :4114-4131). So a click on the pasteboard at off-stage coords WOULD hit an object there. The practical failure is: the object is invisible (above), so the user cannot find it to click; and selection halos/transform handles are themselves drawn inside the stage-sized canvases/overlays, so even a selected off-stage object shows no visible affordance off the stage edge.
=> COMBINED CAUSE: primarily NOT-RENDERED (canvas + every overlay sized to stage-only, clipped by canvas dimensions; no pasteboard render surface), compounded by selection affordances also being stage-clipped. The hit-test math itself is NOT stage-bounded.

REGRESSION VERDICT: NOT a regression — long-standing since the initial StageArea commit 4b4e4cf2 (2026-06-09; canvas width={stageWidth}/height={stageHeight} and resize(stageWidth,stageHeight) both originate there). The 206830f re-theme (task 1245) only added the gray pasteboard *background color* + edge shadow to the work-area div; it did NOT introduce or change the canvas/clip extent, so off-stage content was never renderable.

EXPECTED vs ACTUAL: Expected = a Flash-like pasteboard margin around the stage (e.g. some px/percentage beyond each edge) where off-stage content RENDERS and is fully selectable/movable, with the white stage rect kept only as a visual boundary guide (essential for tween-in-from-offscreen and general off-stage staging). Actual = off-stage content is invisible and effectively un-editable.

FIX DIRECTION: size the render canvas + grid canvas + all overlays + the CanvasRenderer backing buffer to STAGE + a surrounding PASTEBOARD MARGIN (introduce a pasteboard origin offset so stage (0,0) maps to (margin,margin) in canvas space; translate the renderer / overlays / hit-test coord conversion by that offset consistently). Do NOT clip rendering OR hit-testing to the stage rect. Draw the gray pasteboard as the canvas/area background and draw the white stage rect (+ existing edge shadow) as a visual guide on top. Keep zoom/pan working relative to the enlarged surface. Acceptance: place a shape fully off the left edge (x<0) and confirm it renders on the gray pasteboard and can be clicked + dragged back onto the stage; set up a tween starting off-stage and scrub it in. File: packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx (+ packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts if the offset is applied renderer-side).
